units.goal_1: % of persona flights operated, strike days excluded (target >= 98). Driven by world.json assumptions (action_effects), not persona behaviour
units.goal_2: % of canceled or 3h+ delayed persona flights rebooked or refunded within 24h (target >= 90; 100 if none). Driven by world.json assumptions (action_effects), not persona behaviour
units.goal_3: % of passengers (weighted) who complain (app, DOT, card dispute) in an average week, weeks 1-10
units.goal_3b: NPS proxy from end check-in 3a: % 5s minus % 1-3s. Personas are not calibrated to the +12 baseline: read it as a difference from nodecision, not as a level
units.goal_4: % of planned fare revenue weeks 5-10 kept on Kestrel by personas with a flight then (target >= 96)

note: weighted by world.json customer_mix (team assumption); persona counts are small, read with the dashboard's intervals
